blocks.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *myslь. Cognate with Polish myśl, Macedonian мисла, Bulgarian мисъл, Slovene misel, Serbo-Croatian мисао or misao, Czech mysl.

rows: to ponder, to muse, to meditate, to think (over), to reflect
intention, plan, design, scheme; conception, idea
to make a living (by), to support oneself (with); to hunt
(archaic) thought (especially in the plural), aspiration, inclination, intention
invention, fiction, fantasy, figment; imagination, fancy
to understand; to be knowledgeable (about), to know something (about)
